message: Preregistered a real-CoinRun PPO policy whose sole downstream role is to collect action-conditioned trajectories for world-model training.
Recorded the user correction that this chain stops after trajectory collection and later world-model training; no imitation-policy stage or policy training inside the learned world is included.
The first runtime preflight exposed an unbounded CUDA-wheel incompatibility before any PPO update; pinned nvidia-cuda-nvcc-cu12=12.4.131 after a red regression test.
The unified Python 3.10 runtime passed fixed CPU Procgen/action/model checks and an A10 JAX actor forward smoke.
The first GPU launch stopped before update zero because JAX 0.4.35 lacks distributed.is_initialized; added a red regression test and the optional-API compatibility guard.
Started the fixed 25,165,824-transition real-CoinRun PPO protocol on the existing A10 with W&B offline and a 12-hour shutdown timer.
Recorded the preregistered zero-update held-out baseline and verified that PPO updates are advancing under load.
Training, frozen-checkpoint trajectory collection and all dataset audits completed; the final deterministic policy missed SC-1 while both collection splits passed SC-3.
Larger stochastic evaluations showed the preregistered deterministic metric understated policy quality but did not close the gap to the public easy-200 reference.
